descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S18 「两个模式的交接：同样的四个部分，空的部分保持空，app 内发送编辑后的文字，双方都有记录」 Handoff in both contexts: same four sections, empty sections stay empty, in-app delivery of the edited text with a record on both sides

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8a Handoff structure: four sections (active issues, discharge barriers, pending results, to-do/if-then), the same in Hospital and Nursing Home, with no separate Nursing Home format（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 11；TFA-92586 AC 3；UAT TC-08） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U8b Handoff delivery is identical in both contexts. It is generated and delivered in-app only, to a signed-in recipient account (never an email address). …（UAT TC-21；TFA-92599 AC 11；TFA-92586 AC 4；TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7；TFA-92586 AC 8；TFA-92586 AC 9；UAT TC-08） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U8c Handoff sections are filled only from stored data. An empty section stays empty (no invented discharge barriers or pending results), in both contexts.（TFA-92586 AC 5；UAT 3.4；UAT TC-08） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Sender = fixture physician (one Hospital patient, one NH resident, neither with a discharge task or stored labs); recipient = a second @roundai.test physician with a known name ({recipient}) in its own browser

When Sender taps Handoff in Hospital, waits for generation, saves the sheet; edits it to add the line 'QA-EDIT-T21-H', sends to {recipient} (Skip any follow-up question). Switch to Nursing Home and repeat with 'QA-EDIT-T21-N'. Open Handoffs → Sent. The recipient opens Handoffs → Received and each handoff.

Then Both sheets have the four sections with no separate NH layout and only their own context's patient. Discharge barriers and pending results stay empty for these patients (nothing invented). Each delivered handoff carries the edited line, sender, recipient and time on both sides. There is no mailto: or email path anywhere. Copy (clipboard) is TC-08 S14.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-92586 AC 3 (structure), AC 4 and AC 6–9 (delivery), AC 5 + UAT 3.4 (empty stays empty). oracle.mjs per checkpoint; {today} on both records stands in for the timestamp. Empty sections are judged once oracle.mjs can read the text under a heading. Until then the lane B handoff-ai table (TC-08 S08) and TC-08 S09 decide them.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-21.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
